name: shrooms
description: Watch and run a Shrooms mesh: which peers are reachable, direct or relayed, throughput, what every device offers, when each credential expires, and the daemon's own log. Changes what the daemon can change by itself — name, node mode, services, meshes on and off, joining and leaving one — and restarts it to apply them. Never who is admitted: that needs an admin key the daemon has never held.
